deployments_detail.use: NBA 2K's ProPLAY technology uses machine learning to translate real NBA broadcast footage directly into in-game player animations (dribbling, signature shots, off-ball movement); the ML-powered Dynamic Motion Engine in NBA 2K25/2K26 generated ~9,000 animations. Built by Take-Two's 2K/Visual Concepts studio. [2K / Visual Concepts (proprietary ProPLAY)]

Zynga (Take-Two subsidiary) uses deep reinforcement learning in production to personalize player experiences, e.g. choosing the best time of day to send notifications per user, increasing click-through and engagement across 60-70M+ users. Built on its open-sourced rl-bakery framework wrapping TensorFlow-Agents with Apache Spark and MLflow. [Zynga rl-bakery / TensorFlow-Agents / Apache Spark / MLflow]

Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick states the company is 'actively embracing generative AI' with 'hundreds of pilots and implementations across our company, including within our studios' to drive cost and time efficiencies (while GTA 6 itself uses no generative AI). [undisclosed (multiple)]

Zynga's Applied AI team uses AI/ML for game operations beyond gameplay: coordinating ad sales and user acquisition, predictive systems, task automation, and community-health/toxicity monitoring across its mobile game portfolio (Luke Dicken, GDC 'Beyond NPCs: AI for Game Operations'). [Zynga Applied AI (in-house)]
CEO Zelnick: "hundreds of pilots and implementations" of GenAI in operations — but GenAI NOT used in GTA 6; dedicated AI team reportedly laid off

Zynga deployed T-Plan's image-based test automation platform to automate multi-platform game QA (mobile, desktop, web), replacing manual regression testing with automated suites. [T-Plan (image-based automation)]
deployments_detail.value: 80% broader coverage, 50% reduction in test execution time, $300,000+ annual Year-2 savings

deployments_detail.use: Zynga uses Alison.ai's AI to analyze and optimize marketing creative/ad performance, identifying winning creative elements to improve user-acquisition ROAS. [Alison.ai]

Zynga's Chartboost ad-monetization platform (owned 2021-2024) applied machine learning across its DSP/SSP and mediation stack to optimize ad targeting and monetization across Zynga's gaming portfolio. [Chartboost (Zynga)]

GTA Online deploys AI-powered voice chat moderation to detect toxic behavior/harassment in real time, using Modulate's ToxMod voice moderation platform tuned to Rockstar Community Guidelines. [Modulate (ToxMod)]

Take-Two/Rockstar is building operational ML infrastructure for GTA Online's live-service economy: player churn/behavior prediction, real-time economy balancing, anti-cheat and fraud detection, matchmaking optimization, content recommendation, and large-scale A/B testing (explicitly non-generative AI). [Rockstar Games (in-house ML)]
